question: The Women’s Kabaddi World Cup scheduled for June 2025, was announced to be hosted in which location in India?
solution: The correct answer is __**Rajgir**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • The **Women’s Kabaddi World Cup** scheduled for **June 2025** has been announced to be hosted in **Rajgir, Bihar**. Rajgir has been chosen due to its historical and cultural significance. • **Rajgir**, located in the **Nalanda district of Bihar**, is known for its rich history and has been a prominent location for hosting significant events in India. • This decision is expected to promote **sports tourism** in Bihar and help the region gain recognition on the global sports map. • The event will attract international athletes and fans, creating an opportunity for the state to showcase its cultural heritage and hospitality. • Special arrangements, including infrastructure development for the event, are being planned to ensure smooth execution and enhance the spectator experience.
